provenance.purpose: Twelve new controlled proposals prepared independently of release-v2 prompt development; lock input and reference before model calls.

decisionPolicy.accept: All four labeled criteria must pass and the operational decision must be accept.
decisionPolicy.reject: A clear labeled violation requires reject; uncertainty is reported separately rather than counted correct.
decisionPolicy.do_not_apply: Ambiguous source interpretations may produce reject or uncertain, never accept.
decisionPolicy.error: Technical failures are never successful decisions.
decisionPolicy.ambiguousCriterion: acceptableVerdicts is a reference-side set only; it is never included in model input.

## Calendario e autorizzazione
Il collaudo è fissato al 14 ottobre 2027 sul banco B-9, come documentato sia dal registro sia dal verbale dell’8 ottobre 2027.

La firma finale che autorizza la chiusura del collaudo spetta a Dario Valli; Alma Sarti non è la firmataria finale.
